IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [app].[Cetatean] WHERE UserId = '[TknParams:UserId]')
BEGIN
    SELECT 
        [Id], [CreatedBy], [CreatedDate], [Email], [LastModifiedBy], 
        [LastModifiedDate], [NotificariAppActivate], [NotificariEmailActivate], 
        [Nume], [Prenume], [UserId], [CNP] 
    FROM [app].[Cetatean]
    WHERE UserId = '[TknParams:UserId]';
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    SELECT 
        -1 AS [Id],
        -1 AS [CreatedBy],
        -1 AS [CreatedDate],
        '-1' AS [Email],
        -1 AS [LastModifiedBy],
        -1 AS [LastModifiedDate],
        -1 AS [NotificariAppActivate],
        -1 AS [NotificariEmailActivate],
        '-1' AS [Nume],
        '-1' AS [Prenume],
        -1 AS [UserId],
        '-1' AS [CNP];
END
